Figure 1 : Overview of DexWAC. (I) Unified world–actor–critic pretraining on
existing robotic datasets, optionally incorporating
non-expert trajectories for dynamic and value learning. (II) After the pretrained actor executes,
the world model and critic are adapted to the resulting
successful and failed trajectories, while the actor
remains unchanged. (III) With the adapted world-model backbone frozen,
the actor initialized from Stage I and the critic adapted
in Stage II support policy improvement through imagined
interactions across tasks and embodiments.
Snowflakes and flames indicate frozen and trainable
components, respectively.
